competitors.title: Competitors
competitors.desc: Reads each competitor's sitemap once a day to catch new product pages, posts and landing pages. Turn a discovery into a topic in one click; AI writes the overview and spec comparisons.
competitors.empty: No competitors yet. Click "AI suggest competitors" and AI searches the web for a few suppliers like you based on your products and markets; you confirm before they are added. You can also add competitor websites yourself, or click "Bring in competitors from setup" if you confirmed some during setup. Their sitemap is read once a day: the first read records the existing pages, and new products, posts and landing pages show up here after that.
competitors.no_new: No new pages lately. Checked automatically once a day.
competitors.no_baseline: Still on the first read: existing pages are recorded first; only pages after that count as new.
competitors.url_hint: The home page is enough; the sitemap is found automatically.
competitors.suggested_hint: Add the right ones to monitoring and their sitemap is read daily; "Not this one" keeps it from being suggested again
competitors.pick_topics_desc: Hands the {n} selected competitor pages to the assistant: it looks at the products and use cases they cover and suggests our own topics from the buyer's questions (pages about the same thing become one), saves them to the topic pool and marks these pages as used.
competitors.pick_req_hint: Default instructions for suggesting topics: how many, what to focus on.
competitors.recent_all: Recently updated pages (new ones will show up here, marked new)
